subject.title: chore(pr): reuse green hosted CI from patch-identical pre-rebase heads

question: Should hosted CI be permitted to treat a recent patch-ID-identical pre-rebase run as equivalent evidence to an exact-head CI run?
rationale: This is an intentional change to the repository's CI trust and acceptance policy; the PR body records an asserted contract choice, but the supplied discussion contains no maintainer-visible confirmation of that policy.

options.title: Adopt bounded patch-identical reuse
options.body: Confirm the 24-hour, branch-scoped reuse policy after the declaration and real-run evidence are added.

options.title: Retain exact-head-only hosted CI
options.body: Reject the new equivalence rule and keep hosted CI tied to the exact current PR head.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded patch-identical reuse
recommendation.body: Confirm the 24-hour, branch-scoped reuse policy after the declaration and real-run evidence are added.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows direct involvement in the proposed CI-gate contract, though current-main ownership evidence is limited.
